audited_source_corrections.action: Added the finite-maximum-coordinate case before concluding that every proper canonical-order segment has size below the infinite cardinal.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof explicitly bounds Seg(gamma_1,gamma_2) only when gamma=max(gamma_1,gamma_2) is infinite, then concludes the bound for all pairs. It leaves the finite gamma case unstated.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: அதிகபட்ச ஆயம் முடிவுறு எனில் தொடக்கத் துண்டு முடிவுறு பெருக்கற்பலனின் துணைக்கணம்; ஆகவே அதன் அளவு தேர்ந்தெடுத்த முடிவுறாத கண அளவெண்ணைவிடச் சிறியது என்று தனியாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the unproved finite case implicit; changing the lemma to exclude finite-coordinate pairs.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The canonical initial segment with finite maximum coordinate is contained in the square of a finite successor ordinal, hence finite, and therefore strictly smaller in cardinality than the selected infinite cardinal.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the argument now handle every pair, including pairs with finite maximum coordinate, without altering the infinite-coordinate chain?
